generated_report.scope: Descriptive saved-August ranking preview; no prediction/adoption verdict
generated_report.flag_definition: isolated AND zero same-age top100 opponents AND <=2 top500 opponents AND <=1 top500 non-loss opponent; review flag, not proof of weakness
limits: Archived August inputs, not current live rankings.
Selection, window and eligibility changed together; movement is not attributed to one alone.
Broader ceilings and play-up exceptions remain unchanged.
Structural verification and lower flagged counts alone do not prove every placement justified.
Human review and explicit publication approval remain required.

placement_review.review_type: Assistant source and artifact review; not an independent human or external review
